name: LLM cache
summary: Reuse an answer for a rephrased question by embedding similarity

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: CACHE_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD
env.description: Cosine similarity required for a hit, 0..1. Strict by default: a loose threshold returns answers to different questions, which is worse than a miss because it is silently wrong.

env.name: CACHE_TTL_HOURS
env.description: How long an entry is servable. The only defence against staleness, and a blunt one.

env.name: CACHE_EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Must be consistent across the cache, or similarity is meaningless.

env.name: CACHE_EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
env.description: Must match the model and the vector column.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Expire entries past TTL and report hit rate. Without it the table grows without bound.

operations.title: POST /lookup
operations.description: Find a cached response for a prompt.

operations.title: POST /sweep
operations.description: Cron. Expire entries and report hit rate.

operations.title: GET /stats
operations.description: Hit rate and tokens saved by namespace.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
